core_obligations: Reduce to a presentation: local finite type of the morphism and local Noetherianity of the target produce the diagram of the presentation lemma with h locally of finite type and the vertical arrow surjective (proof lines 5668-5671)
Scheme-level step: the corresponding statement for schemes makes the presenting morphism h locally of finite presentation (proof lines 5672-5675)
Conclusion for (1): the morphism of stacks is locally of finite presentation by definition (proof lines 5676-5678)
(2): finite type plus quasi-separated means quasi-compact and quasi-separated, so the second assertion follows from the first (proof lines 5679-5680)
proof_roadmap: 按展示引理取图，垂直箭头满光滑、h 局部有限型；目标局部 Noetherian ⇒ 展示概型局部 Noetherian。
概型层面的（局部有限型 + 局部 Noetherian ⇒ 局部有限表现）给出 h 的性质，按定义回推 (1)。
(2)：有限型 + 准分离 ⇒ 准紧且准分离，由 (1) 即得。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a morphism of algebraic stacks locally of finite type over a locally Noetherian target is locally of finite presentation, and that the same holds with finite type and quasi-separated replaced by finite presentation (author lemma at source lines 5655-5664, label lemma-noetherian-finite-type-finite-presentation). The proof (source lines 5666-5680) reduces to a presentation square, applies the corresponding statement for schemes to the presenting morphism, reads the conclusion back by definition, and derives the second part from the first through quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness (proof lines 5668-5680). The reduction through the presentation and the passage from (1) to (2) are the content. H2.
